name: Circled
description: Wraps each letter in a circle.
legacyScript: function animate(env,el,p){ var t=el.text,o=""; for(var i=0;i<t.length;i++){ var c=t.charCodeAt(i); if(c>=65&&c<=90)o+=String.fromCharCode(0x24B6+(c-65)); else if(c>=97&&c<=122)o+=String.fromCharCode(0x24D0+(c-97)); else if(c>=49&&c<=57)o+=String.fromCharCode(0x2460+(c-49)); else if(c===48)o+=String.fromCharCode(0x24EA); else o+=t.charAt(i); } el.text=o; return el; }
